metadataReview.note: Reviewed location: Songshan (Mount Song) in Lameng township, Longling County, Yunnan, the fortified mountain attacked by the Chinese Expeditionary Force from 4 June 1944 until its capture on 7 September 1944, as dated on the Longling County government portal. The Baoshan government records the battle site as a national key cultural relic protection unit. The point is the OpenStreetMap feature for that named battle site at Dayakou, on the Burma Road loop around the mountain. It is a site reference, not the summit bunker, a trench line or any unit position. The existing dates are retained. Strengths, losses and equipment are not inferred.

Rounded to [98.9056,24.7396]. This is the named heritage-site feature at Dayakou, which Longling County places on the Burma Road loop around Songshan, used as a sector reference for the Songshan siege; it is not the summit, the main-peak bunker destroyed on 20 August, a trench or a Chinese or Japanese unit position. The separate memorial hall and relic exhibition features nearby are not used. No positional accuracy radius is claimed.
